answer: A single Florist watered root record witnessed at the flower charter does the work of a whole committee: 7-year garden service, 153 supervised plantings, pruning exam, annual tally dues, verified by a stranger. Faking at scale is a payroll: 479 aliases, each demanding 89 POA and 15 minutes, a standing bill of 42631 POA. A opal without a date is a rumour, a umber without a receipt is a boast, and a river without a witness is a story. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
